headline.purpose: Panel and settings section headings at 17px.

body.purpose: System sans at 14px; 12-13px in dense rows.

motion.name: banner-in
motion.purpose: Error/notice banner reveal via clip-path inset.

motion.name: drawer-reveal
motion.purpose: Service drawer opening beneath a project channel.

motion.name: chevron-rotate
motion.purpose: Channel chevron flips 180deg when a drawer expands.

motion.name: tooltip-fade
motion.purpose: Icon-button tooltip opacity/translate on hover or focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button used throughout channels, drawers, and forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #3b3e43; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; background: #222326; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); color: #e7e8ea; font: 500 13px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #50545a; background: #27292c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d58d33; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Action Button
components.description: Icon-only quick action (start/stop/restart/logs, and maintenance actions) with a tooltip and accessible label.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="View logs" data-tooltip="View logs"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 5h14v14H5Z"/><path d="m8 9 2 2-2 2m4 1h4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #a6a9ae; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: #27292c; color: #e7e8ea; }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: A 9px circular indicator LED whose color encodes running/starting/crashed/stopped state; always paired with a text state label.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); border-radius: 50%; background: #6e7177; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); } .ds-lamp.running { background: #8fa04f; } .ds-lamp.starting { background: #d58d33; } .ds-lamp.crashed { background: #cf5a4c; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Project search / branch combobox input with an underline-glow focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #2b2d31; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 10px; background: #101112; color: #7b7f86; font: 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #3b3e43; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #8fa04f; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Dark pill-strip primary navigation with a light active tab.
components.html: Control boardSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; background: #0f1011; } .ds-nav-link { border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; color: #b6b9be; font-size: 13px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-nav-link.active { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #f5f6f7; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #b6b9be; }

components.name: Project Channel Row
components.description: The core signature unit: a compact multi-column channel row (lamp, identity, branch, route, state, chevron) with always-visible quick actions.
components.css: .ds-channel { border: 1px solid #2b2d31; border-radius: 8px; background: #1b1c1e; } .ds-channel + .ds-channel { border-top: 0; } .ds-channel:hover { background: #27292c; } .ds-channel.selected { background: #2c2e32; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #a6a9ae; }

narrative.overview: Porto is one dense, professional control desk for local apps, containers, images, builds, storage, networks, Kubernetes, and VMs: a fixed instrument rail, fused fleet signal and control strips, ranked inventories, and a docked inspector. The palette is neutral graphite (dark by default, with an optional light theme) carrying three operational signal colors: olive, amber, and fault red. Porto avoids the identity accents of other desktop container tools.
keyCharacteristics: Dark theme by default; Light and Match system are available in Settings.
Neutral graphite or cool off-white working surfaces; no beige, putty, or paper tones.
Instrument surfaces (rail, fleet rail, readouts, consoles, terminals) stay dark in both themes.
Status meaning is carried by exactly three signal colors.
Hairline borders separate regions; shadows are soft and subtle.

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only olive, amber, and fault red carry operational meaning. Links use a desaturated slate so they never compete with signals.

rules.name: The Neutral Rule
rules.body: Working surfaces stay neutral gray. Never introduce warm beige or a brand-identity hue as a surface or accent color.

rules.name: The Engraved Label Rule
rules.body: Machine-reported values (branch, port, PID, state, timestamps, commands) render in uppercase, letter-spaced mono at 10-12px; prose stays in sans.

rules.name: The Fused Instrument Rule
rules.body: The fleet signal rail and control bar read as one instrument; control bars wrap actions instead of overflowing.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders separate regions. Shadows are soft and reserved for buttons, menus, popovers, and floating panels; no hard offset shadows.

dos: Keep dark as the default theme and every color tokenized.
Keep instrument surfaces dark in both themes.
Reserve olive, amber, and fault red for health, progress, and fault.
Keep the inventory visible while the inspector is open.
Give the inspector enough width for its forms (--inspector-width).
Give every icon-only control an accessible name and a tooltip.
donts: Use warm beige, putty, or paper backgrounds, or a ruled background texture.
Use pink, purple, or bright brand blue accents.
Use hard offset shadows or radii above 8px.
Hide state behind an icon or a color alone.
